description:
Formalize the acceptance of the 'Legacy ERP - Windows 2008' risk. Navigate to the Risk Management module, edit this existing risk, and perform the following updates:
1. Change the Risk Mitigation Strategy to 'Accept'.
2. Add the text 'Risk formally accepted by Board Directive 2025-Q1 pending cloud migration.' to the Description.
3. Set the Next Review Date to '2025-12-31'.
4. Attach the official sign-off document located at '/home/ga/Documents/CEO_Risk_SignOff.pdf' to the risk record.

Save the changes when complete.
